2123847019546415580.en_summary: Anthropic’s IPO ($ANT) and private placement expected to bring about $105B after fees. Pro forma cash at $232.4B, 3.3x the $70.7B due next 12 months. Committed spending about $901B, including $451B unsigned leases. Payments to Broadcom ($161B TPU), clouds Google Amazon Microsoft ($278.5B), SpaceX AI unit up to $120.5B, others. Hardware includes TPUs, Trainium, NVIDIA GPUs, AMD Helios 2027.
2123847019546415580.zh_summary: Anthropic的IPO（$ANT）及私人配售預計扣除費用後帶來約1050億美元。備考現金達2324億美元，為未來12個月到期的707億美元的3.3倍。承諾支出約9010億美元，包括4510億美元未開始的已簽租約。向博通（1610億美元TPU）、雲端Google Amazon Microsoft（2785億美元）、SpaceX AI單位最多1205億美元等支付。硬體包括TPUs、Trainium、NVIDIA GPU，AMD Helios計劃2027年。
